decisions.rationale: The 2025 NOA ($90,141), employer letter ($90,339) and paystub (about $91,100 annualized) all support the stated $89,500.
Rive-Nord Evaluations is on the approved panel, the May 2026 report values the property at $653,000 against a $650,000 price, and no conditions are noted.
A recent signed letter on letterhead confirms a fixed-term contract continuously renewed since December 2023, about 2.7 years of stable history, consistent with the paystub.
